rationale: EXTR has gapped up 14.2% with no news catalyst identified, creating high uncertainty about the driver and sustainability of the move. The bid-ask spread is wide (58 bps), the 9-EMA is above current price suggesting early momentum fade, and price is sitting in the middle of a compressed two-candle range with no clear directional setup. The lack of a news catalyst and the wide spread make risk/reward unfavorable in either direction at this moment.
